scope: Reusable research-to-acceptance practice; no installation, host qualification, model run or trading authority follows from inclusion.

lanes.acceptance: Exact-source coverage plus explicit no-answer cases; task outcomes measured separately.
lanes.next_gate: Held-out task evaluation on a substantial real project.

lanes.acceptance: A real issue produces a tested independently reviewed patch in an isolated workspace.
lanes.next_gate: Matched correctness, elapsed time and complete usage comparison.

lanes.acceptance: An explicit durable decision is retrievable in its intended scope with cross-scope negatives.
lanes.next_gate: Recovery without importing unrelated histories or another host's credential store.

lanes.acceptance: Interruption, reconnect, cancellation and selected-state restoration have observed results.
lanes.next_gate: Independent-host restore and controlled startup/network-change qualification.

lanes.acceptance: A pinned model/runtime meets task quality and measured resource limits against the existing baseline.
lanes.next_gate: Useful native client integration; inference speed alone does not pass.

lanes.acceptance: A reproducible source-to-result packet preserves time, provenance and deterministic calculations.
lanes.next_gate: Application-specific data and execution gates remain independently enforced.
